x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: working code whose shape costs more than it should to change, understand or run.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the source show working code whose structure makes every nearby change expensive?
signals: duplication, a leaky boundary or a standing workaround is named
behaviour stays the same after the change
the cost is paid again on every future change near it
anti_signals: the problem is untested code rather than its shape
x-okf-proposal-guidance.title_pattern: Names the debt: `Consolidate ...`, `Remove the ... workaround`, `Untangle ... from ...`
